name: Bealiah
overview: Bealiah was a male figure who came to the aid of David at Ziklag, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 12:5. He is noted for his loyalty and support during a critical time in David's rise to kingship. Scripture identifies him explicitly as a descendant of Benjamin, highlighting his tribal affiliation.
namesAndTitles: The name Bealiah means 'YHWH is Lord,' reflecting a theophoric element that acknowledges the sovereignty of God. This proper name emphasizes the believer's recognition of the Lord's authority, as noted in 1 Chronicles 12:5.
familyAndRelationships: Bealiah is explicitly identified as a descendant of the tribe of Benjamin. Beyond this tribal relationship, Scripture does not record any additional family connections for him.
scriptureSignificance: Bealiah's significance lies in his faithful support of David at Ziklag, a pivotal moment when David was gathering strength and allies. His presence among those who joined David underscores the unity and divine guidance involved in David's eventual kingship. The acknowledgment of his tribal heritage ties him to the history of Israel and God's unfolding plan through David.
